title: ModRank: code and results for Parameter-free multimodal fusion with ModRank and a corrected clinical reference for bladder cancer survival

creators.name: Chen, Guanxing
creators.affiliation: City University of Hong Kong (Dongguan), China

description:
Code, prespecified protocols and results for the paper Parameter-free multimodal fusion with ModRank and a corrected clinical reference for bladder cancer survival.

The clinical reference that multimodal survival models are compared against on the TCGA-BLCA whole-slide benchmark is built from tumour grade. Rebuilt with pathologic stage from the benchmark's own files, it rises from 0.5666 to 0.6638 concordance and the apparent added value of three multimodal constructions more than halves. Part of that difference is produced by the rank combination itself, and each model is also measured against a score without information combined by the same rule.

ModRank fits one ridge Cox model per modality on the released five-fold splits and averages their within-fold ranks with equal weight, fitting nothing in the combination. It reaches a concordance index of 0.7212 with 1,049 coefficients on 359 cases and 113 events.

The archive also carries the study's own negative finding: the pre-registered selection correction was mis-specified, and under an outcome-permuted null the reported value does not clear a correctly constructed bar. The 200 permutations behind that measurement are included, and the bundled check script recomputes both corrected bars and asserts the failure rather than leaving it to be taken on trust.

No input data are redistributed here. Every input is another group's public release and the code takes their location through an environment variable.
